camel_example: aliyun apig PUT /himarket/v1/product-categories/category-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"icon":{"type":"url","value":"https://example.com/icon.png"},"name":"ai-capabilities","description":"收录 AI 相关能力的产品类别"}'
description_en: Updates the name, description, and icon of a product category by category ID. The request body is in JSON format. The response returns only the request ID, response status code, and response message
description_zh: 按产品类别 ID 更新该产品类别的名称、描述与图标，请求体为 JSON，响应只返回请求 ID、响应状态码与响应消息
kebab_example: aliyun apig update-product-category --category-id category-xxxxxxxx --description '收录 AI 相关能力的产品类别' --icon type=url value=https://example.com/icon.png --name ai-capabilities --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProductCategory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the product category. This parameter is used to specify the product category to update. You can obtain the ID from the data.categoryId field in the CreateProductCategory response, the data.categoryId field in the GetProductCategory response, or the categoryId field of an item in the ListProductCategories response
parameters.help_zh: 产品类别 ID，用于指定要更新的产品类别。可由 CreateProductCategory 响应的 data.categoryId、GetProductCategory 响应的 data.categoryId 或 ListProductCategories 列表项的 categoryId 获得
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.example: 收录 AI 相关能力的产品类别
parameters.help_en: The description of the product category. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 产品类别描述，最长 500 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The icon of the product category. The icon consists of two fields: icon type (type) and icon information (value)
parameters.help_zh: 产品类别图标，由图标类型（type）与图标信息（value）两个字段组成
parameters.name: icon

parameters.help_en: The name of the product category. The name can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 产品类别名称，最长 100 个字符
parameters.name: name
